dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product puts two things in one region and lets a person give either more room by moving the line between them: a list beside the message it opens, a query above its results, a canvas beside its settings. The line between the two is tuned apart from the product's other separators (a system that draws no line and leaves the handle alone, a system that draws a broad gutter), and the large motion of a pane folded away or brought back is told apart from the small one of a share the product changed.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a split view draws besides its Handle (which is drawn by comp.handle.*): the line between the two panes, and the motions of a share the product changed and of a pane folded away or brought back.
rules: The panes have no fill, padding or corners of the split view's own: the product's content draws its own surface (a list, a card, an editor).
The divider is decoration that shows where one pane ends; what a person moves is the Handle, held to the 3:1 boundary of a control. Never make the divider the only mark of where to drag.
A drag and a key are followed without a motion; only a fold, a restore, a press that moves the divider and a share the product sets move by these durations.
Restyle the handle through comp.handle.* in a layer; never draw a handle of the split view's own.

color.$description: The line between the two panes: decoration that shows where one ends, in the color a divider draws its line in. What a person drags is the Handle on it, which is held to the 3:1 boundary of a control (WCAG 1.4.11).

width.$description: The line's thickness across the axis of the split; the panes share what is left of the region.

resize-duration.$description: How long the divider takes to reach a share the product set. A drag and a key are followed without a motion.

collapse-duration.$description: How long a pane takes to fold away or come back, and the divider to reach the share a press on the Handle gives: a large change a person follows with the eye, slower than a small one.

collapse-easing.$description: The curve of every motion of the divider: a change of place within the layout.
